problem: Can degraded LiFePO4 cathodes be directly regenerated with a single multifunctional organic lithium salt?
mechanism_or_method: Dilithium organic salt refills Li vacancies, cyano groups suppress Fe(III), and pyrolysis leaves a conductive carbon coat.
limitation: Lab-scale coin-cell validation; techno-economic analysis is an estimate.

object: high entropy alloy hydrogen evolution catalysts
problem: Can a spread of hydrogen adsorption energies on HEA surfaces beat the Sabatier optimum for hydrogen evolution?
mechanism_or_method: DFT shows Gaussian-distributed adsorption free energy; larger variance at mean zero raises activity; PtFeCoNiCu HEA synthesized as proof.
limitation: Descriptor tested on few alloy systems; extension to other reactions only computed.

problem: Can target uniaxial compressive stress-strain curves be inverse designed rapidly while accounting for printing errors?
mechanism_or_method: Generative machine learning trained with desktop additive manufacturing data, including process-dependent error compensation, to produce architectures matching prescribed curves.
limitation: Limited to uniaxial quasi-static compression and one printing process; about 90% fidelity.
decision_relevance: Lets designers skip iterative print-test cycles for target stress-strain response.

problem: Can hydrogels achieve high toughness and low hysteresis simultaneously without sacrificial energy dissipation structures?
mechanism_or_method: Sliding physical entanglements as primary crosslinks in first network enable oriented stretching and entropy-based reversible energy storage.
limitation: Lab-scale specimens; long-term fatigue and scalability not shown in abstract.

object: high entropy spinel oxide OER catalysts
problem: How do mixing and local strain control oxygen evolution activity in high entropy spinel oxides?
mechanism_or_method: DFT of mixed-site adsorption energies and strain combined with sol-flame synthesis of five-cation spinel and electrochemical testing.
limitation: Model-experiment link rests on alkaline lab tests of a single composition family.

problem: What multi-cation synergy explains the cocktail effect and reversibility in a conversion-type HEO anode?
mechanism_or_method: Atomic and nanoscale characterization during cycling reveals metallic nano-network plus inert-cation-stabilized oxide nanophase accommodating Li.
limitation: Single HEO composition; mechanism inferred from one material system.

problem: Can multiscale toughening motifs of natural materials be translated into strong, tough biomimetic hydrogels?
mechanism_or_method: Freeze-casting-assisted solution substitution builds honeycomb fiber walls, nanocrystalline hydrogen-bonded fibers and ionically crosslinked chains.
limitation: Mechanism attribution is qualitative; lab-scale samples only.

problem: Can controlling interfacial polymerization yield fast permeation and precise Cl-/SO4 separation?
mechanism_or_method: g-C3N4 nanosheets tile the water-hexane interface, slowing piperazine diffusion and forming ordered hollow nanostructures; MD and CFD explain transport.
limitation: Bench-scale membrane coupons; long-term fouling and scale-up not evaluated.

problem: Can a new membrane-forming process give a narrow pore-size distribution for precise ionic sieving?
mechanism_or_method: Anhydrous interfacial polymerization at a solid-liquid interface between sublimated amine layer and acyl chloride in alkane.
limitation: Lab-scale membranes; water flux modest and scalability unproven.

object: polymer-based phase change composites for wearable thermal management
problem: Can leakage-free, ultraflexible phase change composites be made by a scalable chemical cross-linking route?
mechanism_or_method: Peroxide-initiated dual 3D crosslinked OBC-SEBS network holds paraffin wax, improving mechanical, thermal and leakage-proof properties.
limitation: Demonstrated only in a small thermotherapy module; long-term cycling not detailed.

object: global green hydrogen-based steel production sites
problem: Where is renewables-based hydrogen direct reduction steel economically competitive worldwide?
mechanism_or_method: Optimization plus machine learning over more than 300 locations combining renewable resources, iron ore quality, wages and coal prices.
limitation: Relies on assumed future prices and technology; excludes detailed supply chain and resource constraints.
decision_relevance: Guides siting of fossil-free steel plants.

problem: How can HEAs activate the lattice oxygen mechanism to raise oxygen evolution activity?
mechanism_or_method: Multi-path electron transfer enhances Ni oxidation with weaker Co-O bonds enabling Ni-Co dual-site LOM; NiFeCoCrW0.2 designed.
limitation: Lab electrolyzer half-cell tests; industrial conditions not demonstrated.

problem: Can membranes combine chlorine resistance and high permeance for Mg/Li separation?
mechanism_or_method: Quaternized-spiro piperazine monomer polymerized with trimesoyl chloride gives charge and free volume with no N-H bonds; scaled to 1x2 m membranes.
limitation: Tested in hypochlorite immersion and modules, not in real brine over long durations.

problem: What are the true Young's modulus and tensile strength of monolayer Ti3C2Tx measured directly?
mechanism_or_method: In situ tensile tests on cut and transferred monolayer nanosheets using nanomechanical push-to-pull device inside an SEM.
limitation: Few monolayer specimens and demanding sample preparation; effective modulus depends on assumed thickness.
decision_relevance: Corrects stiffness values used when designing MXene devices and membranes.

object: retired EV lithium-ion battery reuse and recycling pathways
problem: Which reuse and recycling pathways for retired EV batteries are best economically and environmentally?
mechanism_or_method: Process-based life cycle assessment with economic optimization across reuse scenarios and hydrometallurgical, pyrometallurgical and direct recycling.
limitation: Depends on assumed prices, residual values and process inventories that vary by region.
decision_relevance: Chooses reuse-then-recycle routes for LFP versus NMC batteries.

object: liquid crystal elastomer soft crawling robot
problem: Can distributed programmable thermal actuation give a soft robot multiple crawling modes?
mechanism_or_method: Patterned silver nanowire joule heaters in LCE thermal bimorph create programmable curvature distribution and friction asymmetry for bidirectional crawling.
limitation: Slow thermal actuation and tethered power; demonstrated only on lab surfaces.

object: lithium and zinc supply for batteries
problem: Is zinc a more available and resilient material than lithium for batteries?
mechanism_or_method: Commentary comparing global supply chain resilience, material cost and mass requirement of aqueous zinc versus lithium-ion batteries.
limitation: Opinion piece without new quantitative analysis in abstract.

problem: How can recrystallization be programmed in AM metals without mechanical deformation?
mechanism_or_method: Control solidification structure to tune dislocation density and thermal stability so site-specific heat treatment yields recrystallized and non-recrystallized regions.
limitation: Shown for one steel alloy and laboratory-scale parts.
decision_relevance: Enables site-specific heat treatment to tailor properties in printed metal parts.

object: water transport in reverse osmosis membranes
problem: Is water transport in RO membranes governed by pore flow rather than solution-diffusion?
mechanism_or_method: Nonequilibrium molecular dynamics plus permeation experiments with water and solvents support a pressure-driven solution-friction model.
limitation: Tested on polyamide and cellulose triacetate membranes with limited solvents; MD force-field dependent.
decision_relevance: Changes the transport model used to design RO membranes.

object: Ni-CaO composite catalyst for integrated CO2 capture and conversion
problem: What molecular synergy links CO2 capture and in-situ conversion in calcium looping with dry reforming?
mechanism_or_method: Experiments and DFT show intermediates interactively facilitate carbonate reduction and CH4 dehydrogenation at tuned Ni/CaO interfaces.
limitation: Lab-scale reactor tests at one temperature regime; durability not stated.

object: machine-learned interatomic potential for 16 metals and alloys
problem: Can one general-purpose machine-learned potential cover many elemental metals and their alloys accurately and cheaply?
mechanism_or_method: Neuroevolution potential trained on 16 one-component and 120 two-component systems, with multicomponent systems as interpolation; GPU-accelerated MD.
limitation: Covers only 16 metals; training requires many quantum reference calculations and large GPU resources for scale.

object: MoZn-based high entropy alloy OER catalysts
problem: Can one HEA activate both adsorbate and lattice oxygen mechanisms while staying stable in alkaline OER?
mechanism_or_method: MoZnFeCoNi HEA pairs AEM-promoting Mo with LOM-active Zn; DFT and chemical probes confirm dual-mechanism sites.
limitation: Lab half-cell testing; industrial electrolyzer performance unverified.

problem: Can deep learning forecast rainfall-triggered shallow landslides over large areas better than thresholds?
mechanism_or_method: Deep learning model linking rainfall records to 20 years of landslide occurrence data across Italy.
limitation: Landslide inventories are incomplete and rainfall-only; no validation under quantitative weather forecasts shown.
decision_relevance: Supports operational landslide early warning based on rainfall.

problem: How do dynamic active-site changes under working conditions boost peroxymonosulfate activation for wastewater treatment?
mechanism_or_method: In situ Raman and X-ray absorption plus DFT reveal reversible bond stretching that tunes eg orbitals and electron transfer.
limitation: Model pollutants in lab; synchrotron characterization needed, real wastewater not tested.

problem: How can a strong glassy polymer self-heal at subzero temperatures?
mechanism_or_method: Polyphenol nano-assemblies with many end groups in deep eutectic solvent elastomers provide multiple dynamic bonds and low-barrier secondary relaxations.
limitation: Healing efficiency 85.7% at -20 C; extreme cold and long-term durability untested.

problem: Can hierarchically aligned strong, tough hydrogels be made simply and scalably?
mechanism_or_method: Flow-induced alignment of nanofibrils under ambient conditions yields aligned fibrous, densified anisotropic hydrogels.
limitation: Lab-scale fabrication; scalability asserted rather than demonstrated at large size.

object: lithium-ion battery recycling versus mining supply chains
problem: How do environmental impacts of industrial-scale LIB recycling compare with conventional mining supply chains?
mechanism_or_method: Life cycle assessment of greenhouse gas, water and energy for recycled versus mined battery-grade cathode materials.
limitation: Depends on industrial inventory data and assumed electricity mix.
decision_relevance: Prioritizes clean electricity and mixed-metal products in recycling plants.

problem: Can a unified continuous design space and generative model optimize linear and nonlinear truss metamaterials?
mechanism_or_method: Graph-based variational autoencoder with property predictor gives a latent space for generation and inverse design with customized mechanical properties.
limitation: Designs validated by simulation only in the abstract; manufacturability not experimentally confirmed.
decision_relevance: Automates lattice selection for target stiffness or nonlinear response.

problem: How does cathode chemistry affect supply chain disruption vulnerability for critical minerals?
mechanism_or_method: Mapping supply chains for Li, Co, Ni, Mn, computing vulnerability indices per country and bounding uncertainty with network flow optimization.
limitation: Static supply chain snapshot with uncertain trade data.
decision_relevance: Informs sourcing risk for NMC versus LFP battery strategy.

problem: Can a transparent self-cleaning metamaterial give radiative cooling and diffuse light for roofs?
mechanism_or_method: Polymer micro-photonic structure diffuses sunlight, high mid-IR emissivity gives cooling, and superhydrophobic surface yields self-cleaning.
limitation: Cooling and photosynthesis gains partly estimated; limited outdoor testing and durability data.

problem: How can hydrogel fibers reach silk-like toughness with anti-freezing and water retention?
mechanism_or_method: Ionic crosslinking and crystalline domains built in a salt/glycerol/water ternary solvent mimic ion-adjusted silk structure.
limitation: Lab-scale fibers; long-term environmental stability under real use not shown.

object: rapid solidification in laser powder bed fusion
problem: How does melt convection drive solute trapping and microstructure transitions in AM solidification?
mechanism_or_method: Fully coupled fluid dynamics and microstructure modelling of solute transport during melting and solidification.
limitation: Model-only evidence in abstract; experimental validation not stated.
decision_relevance: Guides process and alloy choices to reduce cracking in printed superalloys.

problem: Can sensing, control and actuation be embodied in materials for autonomous soft robots without electronics?
mechanism_or_method: Modular control units regulated by liquid crystal elastomers respond to light, heat and solvents and combine into logic functions.
limitation: Demonstrated only on lab prototypes with simple stimuli and slow responses.

problem: Can thick-panel origami be printed in one step with self-locking and high load capacity?
mechanism_or_method: Wrapping-based multimaterial FDM printing of rigid panels with stretchable hinges, stacked into a self-locking structure and optimized with a theoretical model.
limitation: Polymer FDM prototypes; scaling and long-term cyclic performance beyond 100 cycles untested.
decision_relevance: Enables printed foldable load-bearing and energy-absorbing structures.

problem: Can scaffolds be delivered minimally invasively and then deform and stiffen in the body?
mechanism_or_method: Amphiphilic dynamic thermoset polyurethanes enable body-temperature shape memory, swelling-induced morphing and water-driven microphase-separation stiffening.
limitation: In vivo implantation performance not shown in abstract.

object: fluorinated anion-embedded MOF for ethylene purification
problem: Can one MOF purify ethylene from C2H2/CO2/C2H4 mixtures in a single step?
mechanism_or_method: GeF6 anion-embedded ZNU-6 with customized pore chemistry; DFT and in situ single-crystal structures reveal host-guest binding.
limitation: Lab breakthrough tests only; scale-up and shaping of MOF not addressed.

object: biochar negative emission deployment in China
problem: What are biochar's negative emission potential, cost and priority deployment sites in China?
mechanism_or_method: Spatially explicit techno-economic and emission analysis across multiple feedstocks.
limitation: Relies on feedstock availability and cost assumptions with national-scale uncertainty.
decision_relevance: Prioritizes regions and feedstocks for biochar carbon removal.

object: bioderived polyester nanofilm membranes for antibiotic desalination
problem: Can a plant-derived monomer tune free volume for selective antibiotic desalination by nanofiltration?
mechanism_or_method: Stevioside as aqueous monomer in interfacial polymerization gives an 18 nm selective layer with interconnected microporosity.
limitation: Lab-scale membranes tested with model antibiotic streams.

problem: Can a nanofluidic catalytic membrane overcome the permeability-selectivity trade-off in water purification?
mechanism_or_method: 2D Co@VMT membrane combines filtration with nanoconfined peroxymonosulfate activation to degrade pollutants without brine.
limitation: Stability shown for about 107 hours; needs oxidant dosing and scale-up evidence.

object: pore formation in directed energy deposition
problem: How do pores form, move and get removed or trapped during DED additive manufacturing?
mechanism_or_method: In situ X-ray imaging combined with multi-physics modelling quantifies five bubble evolution mechanisms in the melt pool.
limitation: Synchrotron imaging on limited materials and conditions; generality to other DED setups uncertain.
decision_relevance: Guides powder quality and process settings to minimize DED porosity.

problem: Can a multilayer strategy with topology optimization produce ultrastiff lattice metamaterials?
mechanism_or_method: Multilayer parameterization enlarges design space; topology optimization yields beam-plate-shell combined architectures.
limitation: Abstract reports computational designs; fabrication and experimental verification not stated.
decision_relevance: Sets lattice topology choices for maximum stiffness and energy absorption.

problem: Can an elastomer be both mechanically robust and self-healing through supramolecular interactions?
mechanism_or_method: Coordination and hydrogen bonds give phased energy dissipation; shape memory recovery force closes damage for healing; clustering-triggered emission.
limitation: Healing conditions and long-term durability not quantified in abstract.

problem: Can ceramic aerogels be both flexible and strong for thermal insulation?
mechanism_or_method: Laminated SiC-SiOx nanowire architecture gives reversible compressibility, ductile tension and order-of-magnitude higher strength.
limitation: Small lab samples; scalable production and long-term thermal cycling not shown.

problem: Can Tesla valves with capillary structures rectify two-phase flow and boost heat transfer?
mechanism_or_method: Tesla valves eliminate vapor backflow while capillary structures wick liquid along sidewalls, giving a switchable high-performance regulator.
limitation: Bench-scale device tests; integration with real power electronics not demonstrated.
decision_relevance: Informs switchable two-phase cooling design for power electronics.

object: mixed spent cathodes upcycled to LiFe0.5Mn0.5PO4
problem: Can mixed spent LiFePO4 and Mn-rich cathodes be upcycled into a high-voltage polyanionic cathode?
mechanism_or_method: Deep eutectic solvent regeneration with transition metal replacement and structural design recycles all elements into LiFe0.5Mn0.5PO4.
limitation: Gram-scale only; techno-economic benefits are projections.

problem: Can a bioinspired patch give firm wet adhesion and active injection drug delivery?
mechanism_or_method: Teeth and venom-inspired thermo-responsive microneedles with on-demand release, plus bionic suction cups for wet adhesion.
limitation: Animal-level efficacy only; clinical translation untested.

object: skin-inspired sensory soft robots for implants
problem: Can electronic skin and artificial muscle be integrated into soft robots for sensing and actuation on tissues?
mechanism_or_method: In-situ solution-based integration of e-skin and artificial muscle with battery-free wireless module; cuff, gripper, ingestible and patch demos.
limitation: Short-term demonstrations; chronic biocompatibility and reliability not established.

problem: Can a dielectric elastomer give large strain and high energy density at low driving field?
mechanism_or_method: Polar fluorinated groups and long-alkyl-chain nanodomains raise dielectric constant while keeping low modulus.
limitation: Lifetime, breakdown reliability and tethered high-voltage operation not discussed.

object: loosely cross-linked slightly dehydrated polyacrylamide hydrogel
problem: Can a single-network hydrogel be tough, fatigue-resistant and stiff simultaneously?
mechanism_or_method: Loose cross-linking with long chains plus slight dehydration creates dense entanglements.
limitation: Demonstrated on polyacrylamide; stability of dehydrated state against humidity not addressed.

problem: How do ion affinity and dehydration in MOF channels control high-precision monovalent/divalent cation separation?
mechanism_or_method: Functionalized UiO-66-(X)2 membranes tune group and channel size to widen transport activation energy differences between ions.
limitation: Small-area lab membranes with defined salt solutions.

problem: What defines high entropy in battery materials and what challenges remain?
mechanism_or_method: Commentary reviewing definitions, benefits and open synthesis, characterization and modelling challenges.
limitation: Perspective piece with no new data.

problem: Which equimolar quinary alloys form single-phase solid solutions?
mechanism_or_method: High-throughput DFT with a binary regular solid-solution model over 658,000 alloys; two predicted alloys synthesized.
limitation: Model neglects some competing phases; only two predictions experimentally verified.
decision_relevance: Narrows alloy compositions worth synthesizing for high-entropy alloy design.

problem: Can data-efficient machine learning design multi-property architected materials for bone implants?
mechanism_or_method: ML cycle of FEM and 3D neural networks optimizes heterogeneous microarchitectures, adapted with machine-human synergy to a bone defect.
limitation: Animal bone defect model tested mechanically only; in vivo outcomes unknown.
decision_relevance: Guides implant architecture choice for matching bone modulus and strength.

problem: Can solar vapor generation collect salt passively with zero brine discharge?
mechanism_or_method: Mangrove-mimicking titanium mesh stem and leaves wick water; edge-precipitated salt peels off by gravity at night.
limitation: Outdoor yield about 2.2 L per square meter per day; long-term durability unreported.

object: monoatomic V-based SCR catalyst with weak current
problem: Can weak current assistance enable low-temperature NH3-SCR NOx reduction on a low-V catalyst?
mechanism_or_method: Weak current concentrates electrons around V single atoms, weakening V-O bonds (electron scissors effect) and accelerating oxygen cycling.
limitation: Lab reactor tests; applicability to flue gas with poisons not shown.

problem: Can robust, crack-resistant, self-healable hydrogel fibers be spun in water at ambient conditions?
mechanism_or_method: Spider-inspired aqueous pultrusion spinning creates hydrogen-bond clusters nanoconfined in an ionically complexed hygroscopic matrix.
limitation: Lab-scale spinning; moisture-driven healing depends on humidity conditions.

object: anionic high-entropy doped graphite electromagnetic absorbers
problem: Can anionic high-entropy doping tailor electromagnetic wave absorption in thin graphite frameworks?
mechanism_or_method: In situ pyrolysis and three-stage solvent thermal doping induces anion multibody interactions and localized charge imbalance for dielectric loss.
limitation: Lab powders measured at low filling; mechanism inferred qualitatively.

problem: Can dynamic water gating reduce latent heat and heat loss in interfacial solar evaporation?
mechanism_or_method: Bilayer foam with porous PDA photothermal layer and thermo-responsive sporopollenin gating layer controls thin-water-layer supply.
limitation: Lab one-sun tests; outdoor long-term performance and fouling not reported.

problem: How can switch-based energy management circuits raise TENG energy conversion efficiency and give stable output?
mechanism_or_method: Energy transfer analysis of voltage and charge losses at switches, co-optimizing TENG and switch configuration with storage and regularization circuit.
limitation: Bench demos with small electronics; long-term and large-scale harvesting performance untested.
decision_relevance: Guides power-management circuit design for TENG-powered devices.

object: electrochemical direct air capture with neutral red
problem: Can neutral red redox chemistry capture CO2 from air electrochemically at lower work than thermal methods?
mechanism_or_method: Aqueous neutral red solubilized by nicotinamide hydrotrope in a continuous flow cell, giving high electron utilization.
limitation: Lower electron utilization (0.38) from ambient air; work values estimated, oxygen sensitivity.
